name: Day in the Life
controllingIdea: A neighborhood is not just where you live but how you live.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: Morning begins in this neighborhood - the day starts
narrativeArc.risingAction: Walk through typical daily experiences and routines
narrativeArc.crisis: The unique rhythm, challenge, or character of this area
narrativeArc.climax: The moment that defines the lifestyle - the 'this is it' feeling
narrativeArc.resolution: This could be your life - invitation to imagine

triggerMoments.moment: Spent time in a specific neighborhood
Buyer asked what it's like to live there

questions.question: What neighborhood or area are you featuring?
questions.placeholder: Downtown Westside, the walkable urban village...

questions.question: What does a typical morning look like for someone living there?
questions.placeholder: Walk to the corner coffee shop, past the park where dogs are playing...

questions.question: What's special about the daily rhythm here?
questions.placeholder: You can walk to dinner, grocery shop on foot, never need your car on weekends...

questions.question: What's the defining moment or experience of living here?
questions.placeholder: Summer evenings on the rooftop bars watching the sunset over the mountains...

questions.question: Who thrives in this neighborhood?
questions.placeholder: Young professionals who value walkability, empty nesters downsizing...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a lifestyle aspiration piece. Paint a vivid picture of daily life in a specific area. Help viewers imagine themselves living there.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Evocative, sensory, inviting. Use specific details that bring the place to life. Make them feel the lifestyle.

usageHints: Focus on one neighborhood per post
Great for attracting buyers to specific areas

exampleScenarios.title: Walkable Urban Living
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Downtown Westside - you wake up, walk to Blue Bottle for coffee, the farmers market is Saturday morning at the plaza. Dinner reservations are a 5-minute walk. You don't touch your car all weekend.

expectedOutput.hook: Weekend mornings. No car keys needed.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Coffee, farmers market, dinner - all within a 10-minute walk.
